```{r}
#| label: mvn-bivariate-3d-alt
#| echo: false
# The alt text, saved once for the figure and its interactive widget.
fig_alt_mvn_biv <- paste(
  "Surface plot of a bivariate Gaussian density with mean zero,",
  "variances 1 and covariance 0.8, over x1 and x2 from -3 to 3.",
  "The surface is a single bell-shaped peak of height about 0.265",
  "at the origin, stretched along the line x2 = x1",
  "and squeezed along the line x2 = -x1."
)
```

:::{#fig-mvn-bivariate-3d}

```{r}
#| label: mvn-bivariate-3d-plot
#| code-fold: true
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| fig-alt: !expr fig_alt_mvn_biv
mb_entries <- c(1, 0.8, 0.8, 1)
mb_covmat <- matrix(mb_entries, nrow = 2)
mb_inverse <- solve(mb_covmat)
mb_det <- det(mb_covmat)
mb_const <- 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(mb_det))
mb_x1 <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101)
mb_x2 <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101)
mb_grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(x1 = mb_x1, x2 = mb_x2)
mb_points <- as.matrix(mb_grid)
mb_quad <- (mb_points %*% mb_inverse) * mb_points
mb_sums <- rowSums(mb_quad)
mb_dens <- mb_const * exp(-mb_sums / 2)
mb_n_x2 <- length(mb_x2)
mb_z <- matrix(mb_dens, nrow = mb_n_x2)

mb_stops <- c(0, 1)
mb_cols <- c("#CCE0F0", "#0072B2")
mb_scale <- list(mb_stops, mb_cols)
mb_eye <- list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9)
mb_camera <- list(eye = mb_eye)
mb_xaxis <- list(title = "x1")
mb_yaxis <- list(title = "x2")
mb_zaxis <- list(title = "density")
mb_scene <- list(
  xaxis = mb_xaxis,
  yaxis = mb_yaxis,
  zaxis = mb_zaxis,
  camera = mb_camera
)
mb_widget <- plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = mb_x1,
    y = mb_x2,
    z = mb_z,
    colorscale = mb_scale,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.9
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(scene = mb_scene)
htmltools::div(
  role = "img",
  `aria-label` = fig_alt_mvn_biv,
  mb_widget
)
```

```{r}
  "*(This 3D surface is interactive; see the HTML or slide version",

```

The [density](random-variables.qmd#def-pdf) of $\Normal_2\paren{\vzero, \matr{\covmat}}$ in the example, with [variances](variance-covariance.qmd#def-variance) $1$ and [covariance](variance-covariance.qmd#def-cov) $0.8$.
Its horizontal slices are ellipses stretched along $x_2 = x_1$.
:::
